trip.title: South Korea Trip — Seoul · Gyeongju · Busan
trip.note: Oct 31 – Nov 22, 2026 (22 nights). Autumn shoulder season — leaf-peeping, mild temps, lighter crowds than summer, and generally better hotel rates than spring high season. Prices below are typical nightly USD figures for a standard double; always confirm the live rate for YOUR dates on the hotel's official site.

split.recommended: Seoul 8 nights (Oct 31–Nov 8) · Gyeongju 6 nights (Nov 8–Nov 14) · Busan 8 nights (Nov 14–Nov 22)
split.rationale: Seoul is the biggest city and main transport hub, so bookending the trip there is practical. Gyeongju is compact (5–7 nights = relaxed pace + day trips to Bulguksa & Yangdong Village). Busan is large and spread across two personalities (Haeundae beachside vs. Nampo old town), so 7–9 nights lets you split between neighborhoods.
alternatives: More Seoul: 10 / 4 / 8 (Gyeongju trimmed to a long weekend)
